intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Côte de Crest-Voland (182.3 km)

story: A rapid start created a 60-rider breakaway, with Decathlon CMA CGM Team controlling the gap as the only team without a rider upfront. The lead grew to 4 minutes by the final climb, where Van Gils, Tuckwell, and Johannessen emerged as top climbers. Van Gils won the sprint, Tuckwell took third, and became the new overall leader.
